newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-KLINSMANN SET TO JOIN SAMPDORIA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-KLINSMANN SET TO JOIN SAMPDORIA.

text.p: Germany captain Juergen Klinsmann is set to join Italian side Sampdoria from Bayern Munich at the end of the season.
Bayern said it expected a news conference to take place later on Friday in Italy after a newspaper in Klinsmann's home town of Stuttgart reported the deal.

"Juergen Klinsmann will only comment after tonight's league game at Hansa Rostock," a club spokeswoman said, adding she believed the news conference in Italy had been scheduled for 1130 local (0930 GMT).
Klinsmann said earlier in the season that he wanted to leave league leaders Bayern because he was not happy with the way he had been treated at the club.
He had been linked to several clubs in England but has decided to return to Italy where he used to play for Internazionale Milan.

Sources close to the player refused on Friday to confirm that the deal had been struck. But the newspaper in Klinsmann's home town of Stuttgart, where he made his name in the game, said speculation about the striker's future was now over.
